text:
jules: Poll time 10pm movie night 1-ish soundtrack recs + one tiny novel (<=180p). low-key, slightly strange picks preferred. winner gets remote control for the night. :tv:

omar: For soundtrack 10pm vibe: Yoko Kanno Cowboy Bebop OST jazzy, moody, perfect for night drives. Pair with "The Circle" (Dave Eggers) as a quick near-future snack. :sunglasses:

lin: I'd vote for Afrobeat set Fela Kuti live stuff for energy, pair with "The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao" (longer though) nah ok pick: "The Sense of an Ending" (Barnes) short and punchy. :drum:

sara: How about Hungarian psych-folk (Ivo?) or maybe Khruangbin again? For book: "The Vegetarian" (Han Kang) short & unsettling. :mushroom:

jules: love the weirdness. can we have 2 playlists: "dusk-jazz-noir" and "dusk-world-weird"? sound-bot, can you compile 15-minute samplers? :robot_face:

sound-bot: Created samplers: dusk-jazz-noir (15m): https://play.example/pl/dusk_jazz (expires 7 days), dusk-world-weird (15m): https://play.example/pl/dusk_world (expires 7 days). Included short track notes.

omar: also adding a film rec as wildcard: "Texture of Memory" (made-up doc) — kidding but real suggestion: "The Fall" (visual, odd) fits the mood.

lin: remote-control pledge: if jazz-noir wins I pick film. if world-weird wins, sara picks. stakes set. :mage:

sara: tie-breaker idea: whoever brings the best snack gets to pick the second movie. i will bring sesame cookies. :cookie:

jules: votes: jazz-noir (omar/jules), world-weird (sara/lin). sound-bot: show vote tally?

sound-bot: Current tally: jazz-noir 2, world-weird 2. No abstains.

omar: golden rule 1: play both samplers back-to-back and have silent vote after first 15m. remote goes to winner.

lin: fine. meeting point: living room at 9:50pm. bring headphones for the quiet parts. also lin will bring a small lamp. :bulb:
sara: i'll bring sesame cookies and a lemon soda.
jules: starting playlist queue at 10pm. see you all. remote fight rules documented in DM. :sparkles:
